conclusions: Road boundary discontinuity grows when the frozen road layer is inserted after static suppression. It persists with the saved world color field disabled.
The saved fine world field slightly decreases boundary RGB jumps and blue index on these controls. Its effect outside road alpha*T<1e-6 is at numerical noise.
The complete a6 asset changes no measured road boundary jump in these controls. This identifies inherited background composition as the dominant seam source here.
Same-camera originalRGB already has a positive blue index. Native10K and its learned directional environment carry the broad cool background appearance.

The environment is a learned direction-dependent RGB background added as(1-alpha)*env. Its large additive blue contribution does not establish a physically excessive illumination or camera white-balance error.
